tier1.text: The external anal sphincter lets you choose when to pass feces, the waste product of digestion. This sphincter is a ring of muscle around the anus, outside the internal anal sphincter. The external anal sphincter is made of skeletal muscle, which you can control at will. Except when you pass feces, both sphincters usually stay closed.

sentences.text: The external anal sphincter lets you choose when to pass feces, the waste product of digestion.

quotes.quote: The presence of feces in the anal canal sends a signal to the brain, which gives you the choice of voluntarily opening the external anal sphincter (defecating) or keeping it temporarily closed.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

quotes.quote: A ring of striated muscular fibers surrounding the anus on the outside of the internal anal sphincter.

quotes.quote: The anal canal includes two sphincters. The internal anal sphincter is made of smooth muscle, and its contractions are involuntary. The external anal sphincter is made of skeletal muscle, which is under voluntary control. Except when defecating, both usually remain closed.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.
